Two University of Mississippi students found dead; kratom use investigated

The University of Mississippi has identified two students who were found dead. Officials are investigating their deaths and have issued a warning about kratom, a substance that has raised concerns in these cases. The deaths have cast a spotlight on the use of kratom.
